map.模板支撑布置：理论间距 s = √(单根支撑容许荷载 Pa ÷ 混凝土侧压力 q: Formwork support layout: theoretical spacing s = √(allowable load per support Pa ÷ concrete lateral pressure q); longitudinal count nL = ceil(formwork length L ÷ s), vertical count nH = ceil(formwork height H ÷ s), total = nL × nH; actual longitudinal spacing = L ÷ nL, actual vertical spacing = H ÷ nH; actual load per support = q × actual longitudinal spacing × actual vertical spacing, utilization = actual load ÷ Pa × 100%, total lateral force = q × L × H. Validation: if L, H, q or Pa is non-numeric, or q/Pa is 0, prompt for valid positive values. Criterion: rounding spacing up keeps the actual layout within the allowable load; utilization closer to 100% is more economical.
map.模板支撑布置：混凝土侧压力标准值 q 先按可变荷载分项系数 γ_Q=1.5 放大: Formwork support layout: the standard concrete lateral pressure q is first multiplied by the variable-load partial factor γ_Q = 1.5 to obtain the design value q_d = q × 1.5 (GB 55001-2021); theoretical spacing s = √(allowable load per support P_a ÷ q_d); longitudinal count n_L = ⌈L÷s⌉, vertical count n_H = ⌈H÷s⌉, total = n_L × n_H; actual longitudinal spacing = L÷n_L, actual vertical spacing = H÷n_H; actual load per support = q_d × actual longitudinal spacing × actual vertical spacing, utilization = actual load per support ÷ P_a × 100%, total lateral pressure = q_d × L × H. Validation: if any of L, H, q, P_a is not a number or q, P_a is 0, prompt for a valid positive number. Criterion: spacing is rounded up so the actual layout never exceeds the allowable load; utilization closer to 100% means a more economical layout.
map.💡 支撑间距 s=√(P_allow/q_d)，q_d=1.5q；按间距布设支撑: 💡 Support spacing s = √(P_allow/q_d), q_d = 1.5q; lay out supports at that spacing, each support carries the area s×s, and the count = ⌈L/s⌉ × ⌈H/s⌉.
map.混凝土侧压力一般取 30~50 kN/m²（浇筑速度较快或高度较大时取高值）；q: Concrete lateral pressure is typically 30–50 kN/m² (use the high end for fast pouring or great height); q is a standard value and the tool has already multiplied it by the variable-load partial factor 1.5 (GB 55001-2021).
